title: PGDA LOLA south-pole DEM, 80°S–90°S, 20 m/pixel (LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ)
summary: LOLA-derived south-polar topography at 20 m/pixel from the NASA GSFC Planetary Geodesy Data Archive (product 90), crossover-adjusted. Used for site-scale slope, roughness and hazard analysis (docs/DECISIONS.md D3). Read as windows over HTTP byte ranges; never downloaded whole (2.7 GB).
provider: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center — Planetary Geodesy Data Archive (PGDA)
product_family: PGDA product 90: LOLA south-pole DEMs (20 m and 10 m)

files.name: LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF
files.description: BigTIFF, 30400 × 30400 float32, 512 × 512 deflate tiles, NaN nodata. CRS +proj=stere +lat_0=-90 +lat_ts=-90 +lon_0=0 +R=1737400; geotransform (20, 0, −304000, 0, −20, 304000). Heights in metres above the 1737.4 km sphere (GMT history: km × 1000).

spatial.projection: Polar stereographic, south pole (centre −90°/0°, true scale at the pole) on a 1737.4 km sphere — from the GeoTIFF CRS, checked on every read
spatial.coverage: ±304 km square around the south pole (about 80°S to 90°S)
spatial.vertical_reference: Heights in metres above the 1737.4 km reference sphere

units: float32 metres above the 1 737 400 m reference sphere; NaN where no value.
citation: Barker, M. K., et al. (2023). The Planetary Science Journal, 4, 183. doi:10.3847/PSJ/acf3e1. Data: doi:10.60903/gsfcpgda-lola-spole (NASA GSFC PGDA product 90).
usage: NASA PGDA data, publicly available. Cite the paper and the data DOI.

verification.note: HEAD on 2026-11-04 from the LUNARIS development environment: 200, Content-Length 2696082051, Accept-Ranges bytes, ETag and Last-Modified as pinned. A 1000 × 1000 window (site 89.45°S, 222.69°E) was read through GDAL /vsicurl/ with ~9 MB requested; CRS and geotransform checked. No SHA-256 is pinned: the file is never downloaded whole, so the size and HTTP validators identify the version, and every read is refused if they differ.

notes: Not acquired with `lunaris-data acquire`; read with lunaris_data.remote.window.read_window, optionally caching windows under data/processed/pgda-lola-20mpp-80s/windows/.
The server intermittently answers valid ranged GETs with HTTP 403 (observed 2026-11-04); reads retry 403/429/5xx a bounded number of times and record the retry count in the window provenance.
